senses.gloss:
न्य्-ओचनी, f., Ved. (probably) a kind of woman's
ornament; (Sāy.) a female servant or slave.

न्य्-ओचर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) belonging
to or fit for a place.

न्योकस् न्य्-ओकस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. belonging
to home or one's native country, domestic, home-
bred; (Sāy.) dwelling in an eternal mansion, having
an eternal abode.
न्योजस् न्य्-ओजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, powerful.
